title: NYISO WEST: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-24, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: NYISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables nyiso_dam_zone_prices, nyiso_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-10-25.
citations: New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). Day-Ahead Market LBMP, zonal (P-2A). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `nyiso_dam_zone_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). Real-Time Market LBMP, zonal, RTD 5-minute (P-24A). Via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table `nyiso_rtm_zone_prices`, ERW commit ba88d85d6094.
facts: NYISO WEST, 2026-09-24 to 2026-10-24: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 18:00 local, 10.85 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 08:00, -10.48 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-24: 4.96 USD/MWh.
